We have undertaken a significant range of disabled adaptations for individual households on behalf of Local Authorities, Health Authorities and Housing Associations. Projects range from installation of ramps and handrails, to full additional rooms including the installation of specialist bathroom access and kitchen equipment. Sometimes residents are requiring a full refit from a none functioning bathroom, to a brand new fully fitted wet room that now meets their needs.
